subject.title: improve(diagnostics-otel): make agent-duration histograms usable beyond 10s

question: Should diagnostics-otel adopt this narrower run/harness/context bucket layout, the broader all-duration layout from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97098, or a different maintainer-owned bucket policy?
rationale: Both open PRs change exported metric aggregation defaults for existing metric names, and green tests do not decide the operator compatibility or product-scope choice.

options.title: Choose one bucket policy before merge
options.body: Pick the intended OTel bucket policy, require the selected branch to show real exported-histogram proof, and close or revise the other overlapping branch.

options.title: Accept this narrow policy
options.body: Merge this PR after proof if maintainers intentionally want only run, harness, and context metrics changed now.

options.title: Prefer the broader related policy
options.body: Pause this PR and continue with the broader related PR if all millisecond duration metrics should match one shared policy.

recommendation.title: Choose one bucket policy before merge
recommendation.body: Pick the intended OTel bucket policy, require the selected branch to show real exported-histogram proof, and close or revise the other overlapping branch.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest recent diagnostics-otel metric and migration history in the current files.
